Using the displaydot, you can use your own filter formula with filtergraph~ set to display mode.

when filtergraph~ is in display mode, the 'cascade' message followed by a list of multiple biquad coefficients (up to 24 groups of 5 coefficients) will allow the product of the filters to be displayed. This is useful for the creation of a bank of parametric EQ's
